subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Power Grid Vulnerabilities
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Power Grid Vulnerabilities.

hook.text: In 2015, hackers shut down Ukraine's power grid remotely. 230,000 people lost electricity in winter.

buildup.text: Power grids increasingly use internet-connected systems, creating new attack surfaces for cyber threats.

discovery.text: NERC CIP standards require utilities to protect critical cyber assets and report security incidents.

twist.text: Many grid systems run on decades-old software that was never designed to face internet-connected threats.

climax.text: A successful attack on the power grid could cascade into water, transport, and communications failures.

punchline.text: Hack the grid. Everything else falls with it.

quiz.question: What happened in the 2015 Ukraine power grid attack?
options: 230,000 people lost electricity from a remote hack
A physical bomb destroyed a power station
